name: wasp-dev
description: WASP (Workspace-Aware Spec-based Publisher) — a fork of bee-dev that ships the upstream bee plugin (vendored unmodified) alongside a wasp plugin layering an audit-to-publish lifecycle (audit-prep, bundle/unify-audit-specs, pollinate) on top — with multi-package and cross-repository cascade publishing landing in subsequent versions.

plugins.name: bee
plugins.description: Vendored unmodified from upstream bee-dev 1.9.1 (bee plugin 4.5.1). Spec-driven development workflow with review gates, the Bee Hive local dashboard, and a live agent activity feed powered by Claude Code hooks. All upstream /bee:* commands work exactly as in the original.

plugins.name: wasp
plugins.description: Workspace-Aware Spec-based Publisher — additive layer on top of bee. Adds /wasp:audit-prep, /wasp:bundle-audit-specs, /wasp:unify-audit-specs, /wasp:pollinate (multi-package monorepo aware in 1.1.0+). /wasp:cross-pollinate cross-repository cascade arrives in 1.2.0+.
